title: agent-crew task pipeline
description: Execution graph and stage progress for one task. Lives at {TASK_DIR}/pipeline.json. Written by analyst in Phase 1b; mutated by supervisor at each stage boundary. additionalProperties is true because analyst-emitted dynamic-agent entries and capability-gated fields (host_task_ids) are inherently open-ended.

schema_version.description: Optional in v1 — analyst-emitted pipeline.json may omit it (backward compat). Bumped on incompatible field changes.

task.description: Original task description (mirror of register.json.task; analyst writes this from its TASK input).

stages.description: 2D array. Each outer element is a sequential stage. Inner elements may be: (1) a bare string (legacy single-agent stage), (2) an array of strings (parallel-within-stage), or (3) an object {agents, tdd_parallel} (TDD parallel form — co-spawns test-writer alongside every agent in `agents`). Consumers normalize the three shapes.

agents.description: Implementation agents in this stage. When tdd_parallel=true, test-writer is co-spawned alongside each.

tdd_parallel.description: When true, supervisor co-spawns the test-writer agent in parallel with every agent listed in `agents`. Both must complete before the stage advances. See core/agents/supervisor-stages.md § TDD Parallel Dispatch.

parallelizable_units.description: Optional. When length >= 2, the supervisor enters Sub-Task Fan-Out dispatch and spawns one agent-of-`agents[0]` per unit in a single host message. Absence or length <= 1 falls through to legacy single-agent / parallel / TDD dispatch — pre-existing pipelines are unaffected. See core/agents/supervisor-stages.md § Sub-Task Fan-Out Dispatch.

id.description: Short slug, unique within the stage (e.g. 'u1', 'orders', 'products'). Used as the unit key in stage_agent_status entries and progress event detail strings.

files.description: Shell-style file globs the unit will touch. Used by the planner's pre-flight overlap check and the supervisor's MVP conflict logger. May be empty when the unit creates a fresh subtree only.

brief.description: 1-2 sentence sub-task description handed to the unit's agent.

completed_stages.description: 0-based count of stages whose terminal state was successful completion. Resume logic skips stages with index < completed_stages.

needs_creation.description: Dynamic agents the planner determined must be created at Phase 1.5 before stage execution can begin. Empty array when all stages use builtin agents.

name.description: Agent filename without .md. Must match the name used in stages.

stage_agent_status.description: Per-stage per-agent terminal status. Outer key is the 1-based stage index as a string; inner keys are agent names; inner values are completed | crashed | blocked. Written by supervisor-stages Phase 2 after each agent in a parallel stage reaches a terminal state.

host_task_ids.description: Capability-gated (task_tools=true). Parallel to stages: outer index = stage index, inner is {agent_name: host_task_id}. Populated by Phase 1c-bis. Absence is equivalent to DAG mirror disabled — every reader MUST tolerate.
